versions.changelog:
- No file changes detected; SKILL.md remains unchanged in this release.
- No new features, bug fixes, or documentation updates are included in this version.

- Initial release of the mirofish skill for building MiroFish-style multi-agent prediction workflows offline.
- Provides a structured method: extract scenario, design ontology, build simulation plan, generate forecast brief, and create interview questions.
- Enables conversion of news, policy, finance, or story material into a prediction workflow without requiring the original MiroFish backend.
- Offline execution includes ontology creation, plan writing, report generation with at least three branches, and revision after interview rounds.
- Guidance is included for both offline usage and (optionally) connecting to live backends if explicitly requested.
